_**Agent**_

The interface now has overlapping tabs for each menu component, creating a folder-tab or document-stack effect on the right side of the screen. Each tab is positioned at different vertical positions:

1. AgentNotificationsLog at 40% from the top with a -4° rotation
2. CaseFilesAndEvidenceBoard at 50% (center) with a 2° rotation
3. ThreadBoard at 60% from the top with a -2° rotation

The tabs have a slight shadow and rotate in different directions to enhance the overlapping effect. The z-index decreases as you move down (z-30, z-50, z-40) to ensure proper layering. When expanded, each panel has a subtle glow effect with the shadow property.

When you hover over a tab, it slides slightly to the left, and when clicked, it expands to show the full panel. The components share consistent styling for a cohesive UI while maintaining their individual functionality.
